claims.assertion: Mari said Taygetan electric vehicles draw power wirelessly from planetary towers on Erra and Temmer, with small zero-point reactors as backup.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She said vehicles can feed surplus power back into the planetary network and use magnetic bearings to reduce wheel and motor friction.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari said Taygetan manufacturing avoids planned obsolescence and uses durable, sometimes self-repairing materials; she contrasted this with Earth EVs, which she views as reducing autonomy.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Her claims about Earth EV policy are her opinion.
